checks.assert: A no-fix critical opens a visible item, moves no reading, darkens no tick and does not toast; the same advisory gaining a fix flips it to scored without a new item.
The does-not-toast half: a critical advisory with no fix fires no notification, and neither does a non-critical one with a fix, because severity is the source's own word and is never re-scored.

criteria.title: A lockfile over the cap is not read

checks.assert: A lockfile over the per-file cap yields not_read and an unknown verdict, never a partial parse and never clean. Asserted against a file built to exceed the cap, printing its byte size.

The verdict half: a lockfile the read could not take is notRead, and one notRead lockfile makes the whole project unknown whatever the other lockfiles said, so a cap exceedance can never read as clean.

That §32.6's 16 MB per-file cap and 32-lockfile per-project cap sit above the lockfile sizes and counts of a real scan corpus (§32.18 measurement 4), so a cap exceedance is the rare not_read it is written as rather than a routine unknown.
checks.reason: Both caps are documentation knowledge with one datum behind them — one package-lock.json of 287,417 bytes (§32.6) — which refutes J6's 256 KB and says nothing about either ceiling. AC-P3-32-16 proves a file over the cap is not_read against a file built to exceed it; the values themselves are unobserved.

criteria.title: The health_delta rebuild

checks.assert: After the migration, health_delta carries idx_health_delta_project_ts on (project_id, ts), a layer CHECK and ON DELETE CASCADE, and no column moved. The mirror test reads protocol/schema/protocol.json, enumerates DecayLayer, inserts one row per variant and prints the count inserted, failing at zero; layer = 'web' and layer = 'growth' are rejected; over a bare fixture — a project holding nothing but health_delta rows (R129/F1) — a DELETE FROM project removes that project's rows and raises no FK error, which proves health_delta no longer blocks the delete and nothing about deleting a project. sqlite_sequence's high-water mark for health_delta survives the rebuild.
The mirror: DecayLayer's variants are read from protocol/schema/protocol.json, one row per variant is inserted and the count printed, failing at zero, and 'web' and 'growth' are refused.
Over a bare fixture with foreign keys on, DELETE FROM project removes the two health_delta rows and raises no FK error — stated as bare, so it is no project-deletion guarantee.
sqlite_sequence's high-water mark for health_delta survives the rebuild over a table whose rows were all deleted, so no old id is handed out again.
Rows written before the rebuild come across unchanged, ids included.
R59: 0016's statements, comments stripped, contain no PRAGMA, which inside apply_all's transaction would be a no-op that reads as if it did something.
The cascade-child enumeration 0016 states is compared against the migrated schema's own cascading children of project, so a later migration adding one without the list fails here.

criteria.title: The capability rule, and no write-back

checks.test: useViewState AC-P3-35-6 the key is not offered when nothing carries a reading, and nothing is written back renders in the default order and issues no view.set when no row carries a reading
checks.assert: With no row carrying a reading the key is not offered by the control; with a stored needs_attention in that state the shelf renders in the default order and issues no view.set. Asserted by observing the command stream, not by reading the stored value back.

checks.test: useViewState AC-P3-35-6 the key is not offered when nothing carries a reading, and nothing is written back offers the key again the moment one row carries a reading, still writing nothing
checks.assert: The stored preference returns the moment one row carries a reading, and the command stream still carries no view.set.

checks.test: projectionCapabilities AC-P3-35-6 answers health only when a row carries a reading
checks.assert: projectionCapabilities answers health only when at least one row carries a reading: absent and suppressed carry none, and a computed zero or a frozen reading answers it.

checks.test: the sort ladder AC-P3-35-6 the key is not offered when nothing carries a reading, and nothing is written back
checks.assert: offeredSorts withholds needs_attention while nothing carries a reading, resolveSort maps a stored needs_attention to the default without deleting it, and the cycle cannot land on a key the control does not show.
